places.name: Hat Creek herd camp on the plains
places.note: Augustus returns to the herd after three days, tells of the hangings, and spends the night outdoors in the grass with Lorena.
places.location_hint: endless grass plain, still south of the Republican River, roughly three weeks' drive from Nebraska; west of where Wilbarger's horses were recovered

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Lorena dreads reaching it, fearing Augustus will be drawn to the woman there; he guesses three weeks yet.

places.name: Republican River
places.note: Augustus says Nebraska lies north of it and the herd hasn't reached it yet.

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: Augustus grew up in its mountains.

places.name: Great Smoky Mountains
places.note: Augustus has heard the Rockies are far higher than these.

places.name: Rocky Mountains
places.note: Augustus keeps hoping to sight them and has heard of their year-round snow.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena dreams of Xavier Wanz in his saloon, the Dry Bean, there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Galveston
places.note: Xavier once offered to take her there.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit with the herd
groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp on the plains
groups.hint: on open grassland south of the Republican River; the herd moved on at dawn while Augustus and Lorena slept
